decisions.reason: As an adjustable cardboard quarter-pallet display close to the core offer, it is still a relatively low-cost option to retain even though several years have now revealed only limited visible traction.
The pegboard-back variant uses existing design and production capabilities and remains distinct enough within the display range to justify keeping the option open a bit longer.
By 2022 this standard cardboard quarter-pallet display looks too overlapping with other core variants for its option value to justify continued market support.
The wooden display pallet sits farther from the paper-based core and is costlier to support, so after several years its remaining option value is too low relative to alternative uses of resources.
This media-focused quarter-pallet display appears too niche and overlapping for a flat market, so management would likely reallocate resources to stronger core products and newer development.
